metadata.title: Soulful Mid-Century Portrait Layout
useCases: Soul or R&B album cover art

retrievalProfile.description: A close-up soulful portrait offset to the right with heavy, liquid-like psychedelic script stacked in the upper left negative space.

recipe.visualDefinition: A warm, film-grain portrait of a person in a contemplative pose, positioned on the right third of the frame, balanced by thick, bulbous, interlocking script typography in the upper left corner against a neutral, desaturated background.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject gaze directed away from the viewer toward the left edge
High-contrast between the warm skin tones/yellow clothing and the cool indigo typography
Heavy typographic weight balancing the visual mass of the dark hair
Negative space acting as a bridge between the text and the subject's profile
coreInvariants: Warm, desaturated color palette with a mustard yellow accent
Bulbous, liquid-style script with tight kerning

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the right 60% of the frame, cropped at the shoulders and top of the head.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the dark mass of their hair provide the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold typography in the top left, follows the subject's gaze across the center, and rests on the facial expression.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space in the upper left quadrant to accommodate display text.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the dark hair and light background.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely thick strokes with minimal counters
Bulbous, rounded terminals that appear to melt into one another
Liquid-like flow with varying baseline heights
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'g' and 'y' have exaggerated, looping descenders
Uppercase letters are integrated into the script flow rather than standing apart
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single heavy script style for all primary text to maintain a cohesive 1960s graphic identity.
graphicDevices: Small rectangular technical metadata blocks in the bottom corners

candidateDirections.reason: Similar weight and roundness if modified into a script

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soulful portrait of a person with dark hair, resting their chin on their hands, looking thoughtfully to the left. Subject is on the right side of the frame wearing a mustard yellow garment. Background is a flat, warm grey. Apply a 1960s film grain and soft lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom liquid-style psychedelic script in the top left corner in a deep indigo blue. The text should be stacked and tightly kerned so the letters almost touch.

verificationChecks: Is the typography bulbous and interlocking?
Is the subject positioned to the right with negative space on the left?
Does the color palette include mustard yellow and indigo?
Is there a visible film grain texture?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of the accent yellow
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible despite the heavy weight
Check that the subject's gaze leads toward the text
Verify the indigo color contrast against the grey background
Confirm the absence of modern digital artifacts
